issues.title: Reapply #1274 fixes to legacy branch
issues.body:
Fixes #1274 

This branch re-applies @lilitkarapetyan 's changes to the relevant legacy branch.

There is a remaining issue.  When a duplicate of a message is created, the existing message is removed from the browser.

A F5 refresh shows the existing message is still in the database, but:
* the initial message has its `Reference` changed to the new message
* as the new message is handled in `handleNonInfoMessage` the code mistakenly thinks there is a previous instance of the message, and it is deleted.
